geometry_edits.rationale: Wrap the dominant mass around a courtyard to create a clearer public void and active threshold.
Open the court to the access side so the frontage becomes legible in plan and elevation.
Increase the courtyard proportion to make the void meaningful without erasing the dominant bar.
Deepen the puncture slightly so the section reads as spatially articulated rather than sealed.

graph_edits.rationale: Convert the split-wing mass into a courtyard-bearing composition so the central void becomes the dominant public figure instead of a shallow incision.
Align the public opening to the site access side in the program frame so the court reads as an active entry threshold.
Deepen the carved void enough to read as usable public space rather than a decorative slit.
Strengthen the internal porosity before the split so the main mass feels less sealed in section.

rationale: The candidate reads as a compact two-part bar with some central incision, which gives it a usable dominant gesture and enough hierarchy to register across views. The parcel response is only moderately coherent: the mass sits inside the green boundary, but the open-space figure is weakly developed and not strongly oriented to the verified frontage/access edge. The blue frontage is not met with a clearly public threshold; the ground response is more sealed than inviting. In section, the form remains mostly boxy and low-contrast, lacking a convincing neighborhood-living ground/public sequence or a calm upper hierarchy that would elevate the program. The split creates some void, but the void does not fully resolve into a legible court or entry seam. Overall this is visually coherent, but it is not yet a program-fit massing for neighborhood living.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is more porous and facade-led than the candidate; do not import its surface language.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Compact street-facing massing with a legible public edge and selective openings can support neighborhood-commercial use.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Photographic courtyard atmosphere is not itself the massing principle; focus on void-to-solid balance.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A grounded, intimate public room can work as a clear threshold condition for neighborhood use.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Interior fit-out is irrelevant to massing; use only the idea of a readable occupied void.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Small-scale interiorized public space can reinforce a compact commercial program.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This is primarily a tower reference and risks wrong scale/typology transfer for the candidate.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A strong ground podium can anchor a larger mass above.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Counterfactual reference is much more section-driven and elongated than the candidate; translate the public ribbon/terrace principle, not the shape.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Sectional continuity and terrace/court logic can create a neighborhood-oriented mass with active ground.

warnings: The form is still close to a generic rectilinear extrusion with a shallow central cut.
Public edge response is underdeveloped relative to the verified access frontage.
Section logic does not yet strongly express the neighborhood-living contract of active ground + public void + calm upper mass.
